thisMayTakeSeconds: This may take a few seconds
taskBackupDescription: Creates a backup of the ratings database and rotates old backups.
taskHealthDescription: Scans the ratings database for stale entries and heals ratings with outdated item IDs.
taskPlexSyncDescription: Automatically imports ratings from a configured Plex Media Server.
cfgAllowUsersToRate: Allow users to rate movies, TV shows, episodes, and music. Ratings and reviews are visible to all users on the server via the web interface.
cfgPluginVersionsInstalledOn: Plugin versions installed on this server, newest first.
cfgMigrationIntro: Starting with version 1.12.0, User Ratings uses a 10-star rating scale with half-star precision (previously 5-star). If you have existing ratings, you can convert them to the new scale below.
cfgMigrationBackupNote: A backup of ratings.json will be created automatically before migration.
cfgNumberOfItemsTo: Number of items to display per page in the Rated Movies, Rated Shows, and Watched sections. Default is 10.
cfgControlHowRatingBadges: Control how rating badges appear on item cards across Jellyfin.
cfgShowTheCommunityAverage: Show the community average rating (star) on item cards
cfgAverageBadgePositionHelp: Corner or edge of the card where the average rating badge appears.
cfgShowYourPersonalRating: Show your personal rating (heart) on item cards
cfgPersonalBadgePositionHelp: Corner or edge of the card where your personal rating badge appears. When both badges share the same position, the personal badge stacks below (top) or above (bottom) the average badge.
cfgAutomaticallyMarkItemsAs: Automatically mark items as Jellyfin favorites when rated at or above this threshold (1–10). Set to 0 to disable. When enabled, deleting a rating always removes the favorite.
cfgOneTimeScanMarks: One-time scan: marks all currently-rated items that meet the threshold as favorites.
cfgAutomaticallyBackUpThe: Automatically back up the ratings database. Backups are stored as timestamped JSON files and rotated to keep only the most recent ones.
cfgAutomaticallyBackUpRatings: Automatically back up ratings on a schedule
cfgHowOftenToCreate: How often to create an automatic backup. Default is every 24 hours.
cfgNumberOfBackupFiles: Number of backup files to retain. Oldest backups are deleted when this limit is exceeded. Default is 7.
cfgDirectoryWhereBackupFiles: Directory where backup files are stored. Leave empty to use the default path.
cfgUploadAJsonBackup: Upload a JSON backup file to add it to the backup directory. You can then restore from it.
cfgSynchronizeYourRatingsFrom: Synchronize your ratings from a Plex Media Server. Ratings are matched to Jellyfin items using IMDB, TMDB, and TVDB identifiers.
cfgTheUrlOfYour: The URL of your Plex Media Server, including the port (default: 32400).
cfgPlexTokenHelp: Your Plex authentication token. How to find your Plex token. Leave blank to keep the stored token.
cfgAutomaticallySyncRatingsAnd: Automatically sync ratings and optionally watch history from Plex on a schedule. These settings are saved and applied periodically.
cfgAutomaticallySyncFromPlex: Automatically sync from Plex on a schedule
cfgImportRatingsFromPlex: Import ratings from Plex into Jellyfin.
cfgSyncAllWatchHistory: Sync all watch history from Plex and mark items as played in Jellyfin. This includes all movies and episodes you've watched on Plex, not just rated items.
cfgTheJellyfinUserTo: The Jellyfin user to sync Plex ratings and watch history for.
cfgSyncConflictSkip: Skip — Keep existing Jellyfin rating unchanged
cfgSyncConflictOverwrite: Overwrite — Plex/imported rating always replaces existing
cfgSyncConflictKeepHigher: Keep Higher — Higher rating wins; equal ratings keep existing
cfgSyncConflictHelp: How to resolve conflicts when importing from Plex encounters an existing Jellyfin rating. Affects both manual import and scheduled sync.
cfgHowOftenToSync: How often to sync from Plex automatically. Default is every 24 hours.
cfgThesePlexItemsCould: These Plex items could not be matched to Jellyfin items.
cfgCheckTheRatingsDatabase: Check the ratings database for consistency. Ratings with stale item IDs (items no longer in the library) can be healed by matching provider IDs (IMDB, TMDB, TVDB) or cleared.
cfgRunHealthCheckAnd: Run health check and healing on schedule
cfgHowOftenTheScheduled: How often the scheduled task checks and heals stale ratings. Default is 30 minutes.
cfgHealConflictSkip: Skip — Prefer Jellyfin ratings; same source keeps newer
cfgHealConflictOverwrite: Overwrite — Plex/imported ratings always win; same source keeps newer
cfgHealConflictKeepHigher: Keep Higher — Higher rating wins; equal ratings keep newer
cfgHealConflictHelp: How to resolve conflicts when healing re-links an orphaned rating to an item that already has a rating. This setting is independent from the Plex import conflict mode.
cfgTheseRatingsCanBe: These ratings can be healed by matching their provider IDs (IMDB, TMDB, TVDB) to items in your library.
cfgTheseRatingsWereSuccessfully: These ratings were successfully re-linked to items in your library.
cfgConflictsHelp: These ratings could not be healed because the target item already has a rating. The incoming rating is preserved at its old key and will appear as recoverable in future health checks.
cfgStaleItemsHelp: These ratings could not be matched to any library item by ItemId or provider IDs.
cfgPermanentlyDeleteAllUser: Permanently delete all user ratings from the database. This action cannot be undone.
cfgClearStaleRemovesRatings: Clear Stale: removes ratings that cannot be matched to any library item by any ID. Run "Check Database Health" first to see which ratings are stale.
cfgMsgTokenStored: Token is stored (leave blank to keep)
cfgMsgConfirmClearToken: Are you sure you want to clear the stored Plex token?
cfgMsgSelectUser: Please select a user to sync for.
cfgMsgConfigurePlexUrl: Please configure and save the Plex server URL first.
cfgMsgEnableOneSync: Please enable at least one: Sync Ratings or Sync Watch History.
cfgMsgConfirmDeleteAll1: Are you ABSOLUTELY sure you want to delete ALL user ratings? This cannot be undone!
cfgMsgConfirmDeleteAll2: This will permanently delete all ratings from all users. Continue?
cfgMsgConfirmClearStale1: Are you sure you want to clear all stale ratings? These ratings cannot be matched to any library item. This cannot be undone!
cfgMsgConfirmClearStale2: This will permanently remove stale ratings. Continue?
cfgMsgSelectFile: Please select a file to upload.
cfgMsgNoBackups: No backup files found on disk.
cfgMsgConfirmRestore: Are you sure you want to restore from "{0}"? This will replace ALL current ratings with the backup data. A pre-restore backup will be created automatically.
cfgMsgConfirmDeleteBackup: Are you sure you want to permanently delete "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
cfgMsgCollectionWarning: Collection match only — verify before healing
cfgMsgAbove5Warning_one: {0} rating already exceeds the old 5-star limit. This could mean the database was previously migrated. Ratings above 5 will NOT be modified. Only ratings ≤ 5 will be doubled.
cfgMsgAbove5Warning_other: {0} ratings already exceed the old 5-star limit. This could mean the database was previously migrated. Ratings above 5 will NOT be modified. Only ratings ≤ 5 will be doubled.
